about_the_game:
Stay in control and clear the night skies! Scramble Star Crossing is a fast-paced, competitive Match-3 featuring a character-driven narrative and a cast of lovable characters. Clear fast and utilise character abilities to out-think and out-play your opponent, and you’ll become a true Star Clearer in no time.

FEATURES

  • Play as a roster of up to 15 unlockable characters - including Alice, an energetic Star Clearer rookie surrounded by heroes she’s only ever admired from afar. In a character-focused story mode, guide her through the pressure, rivalries and unexpected friendships of the Annual Star Clearer’s Competition, as she begins to uncover the origins of the rainbow star-storms and her own place in the skies.

  • Match stars to clear the skies against an opponent with 2-4 player battles both locally and online including Versus, Tag Team and Free-For-All modes with seasonal content and exclusive unlockable rewards.

  • Hone your skills in our singleplayer and story modes, including Clear The Crossing, Time Trail, Quota Trial, Marathon, Arcade, Zen and more!

  • Play as Alice the Rookie, Regis the Champion, Gismo the Robot alongside 12+ other whimsical playable characters to choose from, each with their own unique abilities!

  • Team up with a friend and prove you’re the best duo by clearing the skies together in online team battles!

WHO SAID STAR GAZING WAS RELAXING? BATTLE YOUR FRIENDS!

On planet Nesson, Star Clearing is both an occupation, and a sporting event! Start your journey as a Star Clearer by climbing the ranks in single-player, learning how each character plays and mastering timing, combos and abilities. When you’re ready, join a friend for multiplayer battles locally or online. In Versus Mode, sparks fly as combatants send confounding effects to each other in an attempt to make their adversaries top out. In Quota Mode, be the fastest to clear a number of stars to be crowned champion. In Time Trail mode, quickly compete purely for points to come out on top. 

CAN’T BEAT EM? JOIN EM!


Ready to show your friends how skilled you are? Compete against other players locally and online in intense 4 player matches - or stand alone against all opponents in free-for-all and fight to be the last Star Clearer standing. Want some backup? Prove you’re the best duo and team up with other players to compete in frantic 4 player tag team matches! 

UNCOVER THE STAR CLEARER’S SECRETS

Play as Alice, a young star clearer rookie, as she visits the Shooting Star Festival with her friends Shest, a fellow student, and Gismo, the affable robot. Little does she know, Shest has a big surprise waiting for her… throwing her into the deep end of the Annual Star Clearer’s Competition, against the two-time winner Regis - and forcing Alice to decide whether she’s ready to step out of her comfort zone and into the spotlight.

short_description: Embark on a stellar action-puzzle adventure! Scramble Star Crossing is a competitive-puzzle game with a cast of wild characters, each with their own powers. Hone your skills as a Star Clearer single-player modes, or take the fight online with 2–4 player matches to become the star clearer champion!
